title: B7_43 quantitative proteomics reanalysis

specimen.description: Archival treated rectal resection; vendor sample label B7_43
specimen.aliquot_chain_status: Exact section/extraction chain and suffix _43 unresolved
specimen.related_resection_block_note: B4 / M-SAMPLE-002 is a different block from the same resection, not this proteomics aliquot.

controls.run_423: Biological identity unknown; not used as normal or technical replicate
controls.AO: 4186 positive quantities exactly match public HPA colon tissue summary from one donor; not matched patient normal

relative_expression_caveats: Within-run protein ranks and cross-study rank shifts are exploratory, not clinical patient-population percentiles, concentrations or tumour-normal fold changes.
HPA colon has three tissue measurements from one donor. Komor normal run/donor mapping is incomplete.
Muscle/stromal composition, fixation, platform and batch remain confounded; no tumour-purity estimate or missing-value imputation.
Public CPTAC paired statistics and public ppb-iBAQ summaries concern separate cohorts, not this patient.

clinical_priorities.interpretation: Prioritize current programme-specific FAP PET/retention/dosimetry if a feasible radioligand route exists; relative signal remains compartment-dependent.
Strong target identification, not unusual Astral-reference elevation; assess current malignant-cell membrane localization and trial criteria.
Conditional secondary investigational leads requiring spatial localization; human CRC efficacy/access less established.
Presence does not establish functional tumour presentation or phosphatase dependence. Full FAP/checkpoint/cytokine/vaccine/PTPN combination remains unvalidated.
Conditional adenosine hypothesis, not activity or response biomarker; ARC-9 receptor blockade is distinct from CD73 inhibition.

reproducibility.included: Processed patient matrices, protein metadata TSV, mapping, prior RNA annotation, search FASTA, contaminant library, expanded derived outputs, audits and six scripts
reproducibility.historical_local_reproduction: Six scripts passed; nine principal output tables matched. Public preparation did not repeat heavy analysis.
reproducibility.reference_downloads: Exact frozen inputs are available as separate gzip assets pinned by compressed and decoded SHA-256. The source ZIP excludes them to keep the package small.
reproducibility.large_direct_downloads: Four large data files are served as gzip only. Their uncompressed originals remain in source.zip; curated-data.zip contains gzip copies instead. Decompress curated copies to the same directory before running analysis, or use source.zip.
